children: Samsung Electronics Co Ltd Sponsored GDR Pfd (KRX:005930) posted record quarterly results and locked long-term memory deals with Nvidia, Google and Microsoft that cover most of next year’s output, while forecasting another strong profit quarter even as 2nm production issues and a winding-down buyback temper outlook.
Previous Week Recap
Long-Term Memory Supply Deals
: Samsung Electronics (005930) locked long-term memory supply deals covering about 75%–80% of next year’s memory output, including HBM, with major tech partners like Nvidia, Google and Microsoft.
€73 Billion Shareholder Distribution
: Samsung Electronics (005930) plans a €73 billion shareholder distribution for the year. Final payout details will be released with Q3 results on October 29. Company cited strong earnings.
Forecast Record Operating Profit
: Samsung Electronics (005930) forecast a fourth straight quarter of record operating profit and said Q3 profit will top estimates, citing tight memory-chip supply and higher AI-driven chip prices.
2nm Fabrication Yields Struggle
: Samsung Electronics (005930) faces production issues in its ultra-fine semiconductors, struggling to run a 2nm fabrication line 24/7 and to keep stable yields, per industry reports.
Global Smartphone Leadership Retained
: Samsung Electronics (005930) retained global smartphone leadership as shipments slipped; demand for Galaxy Z Fold8 and stable component supply supported performance amid industry slowdown.
Record Quarterly Results, Shares Slip

: Samsung Electronics (005930) posted record quarterly results; shares slipped ~0.2% after pre-market gains. Foreign and institutional selling, won strength and AI spending comments weighed on trading.
Thermal Path Blocks For HBM
: Samsung Electronics (005930) is developing thermal path blocks to direct heat around high-speed D2D PHY in HBM base die; validation underway for HBM4E, with planned extension to HBM5
Memory Prices Rise Forecast
: Memory prices forecast to rise about 10–15% in Q4 versus ~60% in Q2, a key factor traders watch for Samsung Electronics Co Ltd Sponsored GDR Pfd (005930) amid device division pressures.
Wind Down Buyback Program
: Samsung Electronics (005930) is winding down its buyback program as part of a combined 55 trillion won reduction with SK Hynix, cutting repurchase volume that had supported share demand.
Analysts Bullish Ahead Of Q3
: Analysts remain bullish on Samsung Electronics (005930) ahead of Q3 results. CGS raised 2026–28 revenue/earnings by 1–4%, kept a higher target and model implies ~6.6% dividend yield.
